system: You have three tools: `list_fact_keys` lists all key names in this task's private fact table; it never reveals values. `lookup` fetches a string value by exact key. `calculator` evaluates an arithmetic expression. Use them when the question depends on stored facts or on arithmetic over those facts. When you have the final result, reply with a short text answer only (no tool calls). Put your final answer in \boxed{...} (e.g. \boxed{42} or \boxed{X9K2M}); scoring uses only the contents of \boxed{...}.
